title: Sharper opponents, refreshed arenas and K-only skins
changes: Bots engage from range, keep firing at normal weapon speed and return from cover after reloading.
Improved arena shading, lighting and architectural shadows.
Distinct weapon sounds, clearer distance cues and bullet-impact audio.
Spawn protection lasts exactly two seconds. Click to Resume does not grant immunity.
Buy skins with earned K: 1,000 common through 3,000 mythic. Real-money purchases are paused.
